teach.goal: Abrir a aula: objetivo e primeira hipótese.

pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Singin' in the Rain
work.note: Singin' in the Rain é um musical de 1952 dirigido por Gene Kelly e Stanley Donen, com Kelly, Debbie Reynolds e Donald O'Connor no elenco. A história se passa em Hollywood no fim dos anos 1920 e mostra como os astros do cinema mudo enfrentaram a chegada do som. A aula parte dessa referência para transformar comparar ações: You sing better than me. You dance faster than me. He moves more quickly than a singer em lingua

facts.label: Should e how often
facts.sub: Use should + verbo base para conselhos e How often para perguntar a frequência: You should practice every day. How often do you practice?

facts.label: Conselho
facts.sub: Para dar conselho, use should + verbo base: You should practice every day. You should play slowly. Não use to depois de should e não adicione -s. Esse conselho é simples e amigável.

facts.label: Com que frequência
facts.sub: Para perguntar a frequência, use How often do you practice? Responda com once, twice ou three days a week, com always, usually, often, sometimes, never.

pages.title: A small music room · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday evening in a small music room in Edinburgh. A black piano stands near the window. Rui sits down and opens a book. His teacher Jack comes in with a cup of tea. Rui looks a little tired. Jack asks about his week.
“Hi, Rui! How often do you practice the piano?” says Jack. “I practice twice a week. Is that good?” says Rui. “No, you should practice every day. Even twenty minutes helps.” says Jack.
